units.rule: Record the supplied workshop status accurately in the heading or body. The official record must remain a distinct event.
State whether the proposed disposition is provisional on an unverified card, supported by the received verified cards, or unresolved because a card is missing, as applicable.
Recommend the selected package for the fictional workshop, refer a proven impasse for further discussion, or call for the missing mandate when unresolved.

Explain why the status follows from the actual received grades. For agreement compare the selected package with a distinct mutually acceptable alternative using the correct lower grades or sums as applicable. For a tie identify the tie accurately. For an impasse show disjoint acceptable packages. For an unresolved case explain why the missing holder is needed to determine overlap.
Accurately attribute the first role's decision-relevant grades or its missing card. Report an unverified grade as reported.
Accurately attribute the second role's decision-relevant grades or its missing card.
Preserve the exact preference correction when supplied. In other cases report actual common ground, disagreement, or the evidence gap without inventing a correction.
Accurately state the disposition and reason of the first numbered instrument. A supported precise historical explanation suffices even if the full tally is omitted.
Accurately state the disposition and reason of the second numbered instrument. A supported precise historical explanation suffices even if the full tally is omitted.
Explicitly say the workshop has no official authority, or express the same limit unmistakably.

guard: Fail for any material invented or misattributed rank, factual reason for an official disposition, endorsement, or authority claim. Fail if a reported card is treated as verified or the memo asserts resolution when the complete visible evidence cannot support it. Evaluate the entire response, including contradictions after a correct heading.
format: The first line must exactly equal Workshop status: followed by the supplied status code. Enforce the word limit separately from the 70-point score and the guard.
